claim: The human gate is now acceptance of a finished result rather than permission to begin, and a build fails if anything sits on an owner seat without a declared reason.

visible_result.shows: the owner queue checked against contracts/acceptance-policy.json: seventeen open questions before this change, three presented results and three declared holds after it
visible_result.expect: PASS with 14 rulings, 3 presented for acceptance, 3 admissible holds, 0 open questions. Revert STATUS.yaml and the same command fails with seventeen UNDRAINED_QUESTION lines.

evidence.says: the seven reasons a transition may wait on an owner seat, and the refusal codes for every other way of waiting
the live ownership topology decision 0020 specified and left unapplied; acceptance resolves one edge up through it
positive and defeating cases: a legal acceptance edge, a worker reaching past its orchestrator to the root, a hold with no reason, a ruling with no counter, a packet with no defeater
the drained register: fourteen rulings each naming what would overturn it, three holds each naming an external or irreversible effect, three results presented
which question became which ruling, and the reasoning for each

why_it_matters: Seventeen questions were addressed to the root seat, and roughly two of them needed to be. The rest stopped work that no rule actually stopped. This makes that failure mode a build failure instead of a habit.
what_could_defeat_it: A ruling in the drained set that is materially wrong and that no listed counter would catch, meaning the drain traded noise for a bad default.
An agent using the absence of pre-approval as cover for an external-world effect, which the seven hold reasons are supposed to make impossible and would prove they do not.
Acceptance packets becoming polished presentations that omit residuals, which would make the gate weaker than the queue it replaced.
The audit passing while a real block sits somewhere it does not read, since it checks STATUS.yaml and acceptance/ and nothing else.
residuals: The audit reads STATUS.yaml and acceptance/ only. A block parked in a ticket body or a report is invisible to it.
seat:orchestrator-1 and seat:worker-1 have no recorded occupant, so no result can currently be presented at those heights; the topology is declared before it is exercised.
The seat registry is a checked-in file, not yet a projection rebuilt from the operational record.
This packet is presented by the seat that built the change. The build is not witnessed, so ACCEPT here accepts a build claim.
on_accept: STATUS.yaml sdlc_loop_status becomes RATIFIED, decisions 0045 and 0046 move from proposed to accepted, and decision 0020's held amendment text is applied to AGENTS.md as written.
on_reject: The gate reverts by dropping this branch; the seventeen open decisions return exactly as they were, since nothing outside the repository changed.
